subject: Cross-border evidence roadmap & UK addendum scoping for procurement
messages:
From: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordichealth.se>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nordichealth.se
Date: 2027-07-18T09:15:00Z
Subject: Request: evidence & UK addendum for tender (Nordic Health)

Hi Aditya,

We are progressing Redwood through our procurement review and need a clear evidence package for international transfers. Specifically, procurement has asked for:

- A copy of the DPA you propose to sign (including UK Addendum or IDTA language)
- SCC execution guidance and whether you use the European Commission standard clauses in full or a TIA approach
- Subprocessor list + summary of which subprocessors process EU/UK personal data
- Retention/audit-log evidence for HIPAA-like scoped datasets (we can provide a sample scope)

Can you confirm what you can deliver and an estimated date? Procurement would like everything by EOD 25 July to keep to the tender timeline.

Thanks,
Elin Berg
Data Protection Officer
Nordic Health

P.S. We may share parts of the evidence with our external counsel. Please mark any confidential attachments as such.
From: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
To: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordichealth.se>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>, procurement@nordichealth.se
Date: 2027-07-19T14:02:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & UK addendum for tender (Nordic Health)

Hi Elin — thanks for the heads up and the deadline.

High-level response and proposed plan:

1) DPA + UK addendum: attaching our current DPA (redwood-dpa-v3.pdf). The DPA includes a UK addendum section; Laura (cc'd) can confirm whether we need to ship a separate signed IDTA.
2) SCCs vs TIA: we support both. For tenders where procurement insists on SCC execution we can provide guidance and an execution checklist (scc-execution-guide.pdf attached). Where customers prefer a TIA/DTIA, we can provide a documented scoping statement and our technical/organizational safeguards.
3) Subprocessor map: we'll provide a CSV roll-up with regions and data paths — Priyom will lead collection.
4) Logs/retention: we can provide a statement of retention periods and sample audit log exports for the scopes you share.

Proposed timeline:
- 19 Jul: legal confirms DPA/UK addendum stance (Laura)
- 20–21 Jul: Priyom compiles subprocessor rollup and retention statement
- 22 Jul: I will deliver the consolidated evidence package (PDF bundle + links)

If 25 Jul is a hard procurement cutoff we should be able to meet it; I will prioritise. If legal requires redlines to the DPA we may need to extend slightly depending on complexity (we will flag immediately).

Action items I will own: collated package, redwood point of contact for procurement, and delivery to your secure folder.

-Aditya
Aditya Rao

From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
To: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordichealth.se>, Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>
Cc: Priyom Das <priyom.das@redwood.com>
Date: 2027-07-20T10:30:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & UK addendum for tender (Nordic Health)

Elin / Aditya — quick clarifications from legal: 

- The attached DPA (redwood-dpa-v3.pdf) contains an optional UK addendum section. For customers requiring a separate UK IDTA we typically execute the UK Addendum as a signature page on top of the DPA. If you prefer an IDTA-style standalone agreement, let us know and we will prepare that.

- For SCCs we have two modes: (a) full SCCs executed where customer wants clause-by-clause adoption; or (b) SCCs + documented technical safeguards (TIA) where customers prefer a TIA risk-based approach. Please confirm procurement preference.

- Subprocessor detail: Priyom, please attach the subprocessor_rollup.csv with region and processing purpose. Include a column that marks whether the vendor processes EU and/or UK data.

- Evidence types we can provide today: SOC 2 report (summary + control mapping), encryption-at-rest KMS architecture diagram, retention policy excerpt, and sample log export (anonymised). We cannot share full raw logs; we will provide sampled, redacted exports where needed.

I have attached a starter CSV for the subprocessor rollup. Priyom — could you confirm ETA for the completed list?

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Privacy & Compliance
Redwood Inference
laura.bennett@redwood.com
From: Elin Berg <elin.berg@nordichealth.se>
To: Aditya Rao <aditya.rao@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement@nordichealth.se
Date: 2027-07-21T08:05:00Z
Subject: Re: Request: evidence & UK addendum for tender (Nordic Health)

Thanks — this is helpful. A few specifics from procurement counsel:

- They prefer a signed DPA with the UK addendum/IDTA executed as part of the agreement (single signed package). If you can provide a signature-ready PDF of the DPA + UK addendum by 22 Jul that would be ideal.
- For SCCs vs TIA: procurement is neutral but needs the SCC execution checklist so their legal team can review.
- Subprocessors: please identify any subprocessors that store encryption keys or handle plaintext PHI fields — those are deal blockers for us.
- Evidence delivery: we will accept redacted log exports and SOC 2 + control mappings.

We also work with an external assurance partner (EuroCloud Assurance) who may request a short call to validate the control mapping; can you confirm availability for a 30-minute call on 23 Jul afternoon CET?

Regards,
Elin
